main.title: Summary
text: Security engineer with 7 years of experience in application security and cloud security for fintech companies. I embed security into the development lifecycle and work closely with developers rather than gatekeeping.

items.heading: Senior AppSec Engineer — Example Payments
bullets: Built a security champions program across 12 teams.
Integrated Semgrep and Trivy into CI pipelines; critical findings fixed before release.
Led threat modeling sessions for new payment flows (STRIDE).
Coordinated the bug bounty program and triaged reports.

items.heading: Penetration Tester — Sample Security Consulting
bullets: Performed web, mobile and network penetration tests for 40+ clients.
Wrote reports and remediation guidance; scripted tooling in Python.
